case_number: 2024 INSC 1007; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. _______ OF 2024 (Arising out of SLP(Crl.) No. 8700 of 2023)

parties.respondent: Central Bureau Of Investigation And Ors

summary: Double jeopardy vs de novo investigation; scope of Section 300 Cr.P.C. in case of remand for reinvestigation post-acquittal; honorable vs conditional acquittal distinction; Article 20(2) applicability; CBI reinvestigation permissible after High Court quashed trial court's death sentence and directed fresh probe; retrial not barred where prior acquittal accompanied by reinvestigation order; reliance on Best Bakery case precedent; final judgment on merits remains pending.
final_judgment: Leave granted to proceed with trial; High Court order upholding validity of CBI reinvestigation upheld; quashing petition dismissed; trial court directed to conclude proceedings within 30 days.
